svg.text: Security controls in layers - every request and every action passes each one
Status of each control is in the control register (appendix). Grey text names the <client>-side dependency where a control relies on the hosting environment.
1 Edge and network
TLS reverse proxy / WAF is the only inbound path · API port private · outbound allow-list to enabled tools only · TLS verified on every outbound call
default-deny Kubernetes network policies · no SSH / management port · no Docker socket · request body cap 30 MB · rate limit 20/s (burst 120) per client
<client>: proxy, firewall / egress allow-list, WAF
2 Identity
Entra ID SSO (RS256 tokens: audience, issuer, tenant, expiry checked) · MFA via Conditional Access · step-up MFA for approvals, rollback, policy, kill switch, access
per-token and per-user revocation · API keys hashed, expiring, never approvers · break-glass: sealed secret, 15-minute audited session, critical finding
<client>: app registration, app roles to groups, Conditional Access
3 Authorisation in the user's context
6 roles (least privilege) · domain scope per role (phishing / incident / vulnerability) - out-of-scope records answer "not found" in screens, reports, audit and access logs
each permission counts only in the domain of the role granting it · human-only permissions · separation of duties (no self-approval; privileged grants need a second admin, 90 days)
4 Action governance (no write without it)
single action layer · autonomy policy L0-L4, default L2 recommend · four-eyes on high-impact types · destructive types never autonomous · target limits · VIP / critical assets
durable kill switch · per-tool pause and stage ceiling (fake / record / read / recommend / automate) · idempotent, exactly-once execution · roll back through the same policy
5 AI controls
the model never decides (figures, verdicts, scores, actions computed in code) · pseudonymisation before any prompt leaves · approved endpoints only · citations validated, invented figures removed
model output parsed as untrusted · read-only tools only · budgets and per-person limits · model versions checked before use · every call logged · LLM off = identical decisions
6 Data protection
TLS to PostgreSQL (verify-full enforced in production) · stored e-mails, reports, raw payloads and AI credentials sealed with Fernet (rotatable keys) · secrets as vault files
retention per data class with automatic legal hold for open cases · minimisation (DNS: security categories only) · logs carry no secrets, query strings or bodies
<client>: database encryption at rest, vault, backups, key escrow
7 Accountability
hash-chained append-only audit (database refuses update / delete) · hourly anchors to the SIEM · access log of every request · trace id from request to model call to job · self-check hourly
8 Supply chain and runtime
hash-locked dependencies · digest-pinned base images and CI actions · SBOM (CycloneDX) · bandit, ruff, pip-audit, Trivy · image-signing pipeline and admission policy · non-root, no package manager
